name: VC Dimension
definition: For $\mathcal H\subseteq2^{\mathcal X}$, the **VC dimension** $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)$ is the largest $|S|$ for which $S\subseteq\mathcal X$ is shattered: $$\mathcal H_{|S}=2^S.$$
graph_summary: The largest number of coordinates on which every binary labeling is realized.
origin_references: Introduced in the foundational work of Vapnik and Chervonenkis, \cite{vapnik1971uniform}.

doubly_monotonic.proof: By definition, being monotonic under both subfamilies and projections is doubly monotonic.

c_monotonic.proof: A conditioning is restriction to a subfamily followed by a projection; hence doubly monotonicity implies c-monotonicity.

monotonic.proof: Every set shattered by a subfamily is also shattered by the containing class.

p_monotonic.proof: Every set shattered by a projection is shattered by the original class on the same coordinates.

strictly_monotonic.proof: Counterexample to strict c-monotonicity: for $\mathcal H=\{000,001,011,100\}$, conditioning the third coordinate gives two fibres of VC dimension 1, while $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)=1$.
